headline: US and Japan reportedly join forces to support yen; Reuters: Japanese finance minister to confirm on the 3rd | International
summary: Two Japanese officials told Reuters that Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama will announce joint US-Japan action in the currency market to halt the yen's decline. The aim is to prevent a new 40-year low.
why: The yen is a major funding and reserve currency, and coordinated official intervention can sharply move the dollar-yen rate that global investors and carry trades depend on.
why_moved: Reported joint US-Japan action in the currency market is aimed at stopping continued yen depreciation and preventing a new 40-year low.
